hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students and young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: This global engineering hackathon invites teams led by engineering students to solve challenges in sustainable transport engineering. Participants work remotely in teams of 3 to 5 to design innovative engineering solutions.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students or young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites engineering students and young engineers to solve real-world challenges in sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams to build and submit innovative solutions for global impact.

hackathons.title: hackodisha-6.0
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students and developers
hackathons.summary: This online hackathon provides a platform for student developers to build software projects without domain restrictions. Participants work in teams to turn creative tech ideas into functional prototypes.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days
hackathons.eligibility: Students and early-career developers across India
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is an online AI engineering hackathon designed for students and early-career developers across India. Participants focus on shipping innovative artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students in India
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is an online AI engineering hackathon open to participants across India. Developers focus on building AI agents, automations, and LLM applications.

hackathons.title: Crate-CTF 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity competitors
hackathons.summary: Crate-CTF 2026 is an online Jeopardy-style cybersecurity competition. Participants compete to solve security challenges across various computer science domains.

hackathons.title: Lean In Hacks 8.0
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students and developers
hackathons.summary: Lean In Hacks 8.0 is a virtual hackathon welcoming participants to solve real-world problems with software solutions. Developers can collaborate remotely across any domain to build impactful applications.

hackathons.title: 13th Protocol: An AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.location: KCC Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida
hackathons.eligibility: Open to engineering and technology students
hackathons.summary: An offline artificial intelligence hackathon held at KCC Institute in Greater Noida. Participants create AI-focused solutions and present their projects.

hackathons.title: AI + Blockchain Global University Autumn Camp Hackathon
hackathons.summary: This global student hackathon organized by Quack AI and Imperial College focuses on AI and blockchain innovation. University students worldwide compete to build Web3 and AI projects on the BNB Chain.

hackathons.title: Capture the Flag by DSCI
hackathons.summary: Data Security Council of India (DSCI) is hosting a Capture the Flag cybersecurity hackathon alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026. The competition features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to Cryptography.

hackathons.title: DSCI Capture the Flag Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students, researchers, and security professionals
hackathons.summary: The DSCI Capture the Flag hackathon features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to cryptography. Hosted alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026, it aims to recognize and reward top cybersecurity talent in the country.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student developers and builders
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027 is a virtual hackathon bringing together builders to innovate in financial technology and Web3. Participants collaborate online to construct software projects over the course of the event.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student developers and builders
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027 is an offline hackathon focusing on AI/ML, Web3, and Generative AI technologies. Participants build innovative applications during a 2-day event at Mailam Engineering College.

hackathons.title: Mailam Builds’27
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student developers and builders
hackathons.summary: Mailam Builds’27 is an in-person college hackathon focused on AI/ML, Web3, and blockchain innovations. Student developers gather at Mailam Engineering College to build and demonstrate technical projects.
